One call takes about 10–30 seconds; at most 3 per project per day. The AI only gives a draft: the current learning map does not change until you click save.

A learning map splits what you want to learn into concepts and draws "understand A before reading B"; recommendations pick papers from the concepts you can read now, and each branch advances at its own pace without waiting for the others.
messages.箭头从“要先读懂的概念”指向“依赖它的概念”。每个概念只等它自己的前置，不同分支: Arrows run from the concept to understand first to the concept that depends on it. Each concept waits only for its own prerequisites and separate branches never wait for each other; the vertical position only shows how many prerequisite levels come first, not that a whole level must be finished. "Readable" concepts are being recommended; "locked" ones are waiting for their prerequisites. Silence never changes any state, and "too hard" only makes recommendations cover the basics first; it does not mean you are not interested. Saving a paper shows interest, not that you understood it: only "Understood" moves the progress.

messages.已检查全部论文；论文内容或类别有变化后，才会再次检查。: All papers were checked; they are checked again only after a paper's content or its categories change.

messages.范围：全部论文。只列出需要调整的内容，没变的不再重复。: Scope: all papers. Only what needs a change is listed; what is unchanged is not repeated.

messages.子类别和论文都会并入保留的那个（第一个）；合并后可以撤销。: Sub-categories and papers move into the one that is kept (the first); you can undo after merging.
messages.保持现状，不再提示: Keep as is, do not suggest again
messages.原类别如果因此没有任何论文，会一并删除（可撤销）。没勾选“调整”也没勾选“保持现: If the old category is left with no papers at all it is deleted too (you can undo). A suggestion with neither "change" nor "keep as is" ticked will come back next time.
messages.没勾选的新增分类、归入和合并，下次检查时还会再出现；只有勾选“保持现状，不再提示: New categories, additions and merges you leave unticked will appear again next time; only a change suggestion marked "keep as is, do not suggest again" stops appearing while the paper and its categories stay the same. You can undo after applying.

messages.其余保持原样，可以撤销: Everything else stays as it was; you can undo
